 These applications coming on for admission this day, 
 the following:
 Order

T h e s e are the first bail applications filed on behalf of the applicant/accused under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail, as they are under apprehension of their arrest, in connection with Crime No.16/2015, registered at Police Station Economic Offence Wing, District Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC and Sections 13(1)(D), 13(2) and 7(c) of Prevention of Corruption Act.

entities.text: Police Station Economic Offence Wing, District Jabalpur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicants submitted that co- accused in the case namely Smt.
Sarla Yadav has been released on anticipatory bail vide order dated 4.5.2023 passed in MCrC No.18100/2023.
It is submitted that said applicant co-operated in investigation and charge sheet has been filed and prosecution agency did not arrest the said applicant.
Case of applicants are also similar.
In these circumstances, applicants may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
3 . Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail and submitted that charge sheet has been filed and investigation is complete.
4 Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

5. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and on ground of parity,
anticipatory bail applications filed by the applicants are allowed.

6. It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicants in connection with the aforesaid crime number and the offences, they be released on bail on each of them furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs.Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Authority.

7. Applicants shall abide by the following conditions under Section 438(2) of Cr.P.C:-
(a) Applicants shall make themselves available for interrogation by a Police Officer as and when required and will co-operate with the Investigating Officer;
